title: Everyday Phrases — Choosing a Streaming Plan
title_quote: I want to watch a new series.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】📺 實用「選串流方案」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Choosing a Streaming Plan
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「選串流方案」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是客服：挑選串流方案：先看有哪些方案與價格，比較畫質與同時觀看人數、問能不能先試用，決定之後設定付款與裝置、建立帳號，把想看的加進片單、調好字幕與音量，關燈看第一集。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Choosing a Streaming Plan' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). Choosing a streaming plan: comparing prices and picture quality, asking about a free trial, signing up and setting up devices, adding shows to the list, and watching episode one. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to watch a new series.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə wɑtʃ ə nu ˈsɪriz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which series do you want to watch?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈsɪriz du ju wɑnt tə wɑtʃ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one has the best price?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The basic package is the cheapest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the basic service?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a few dollars a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə fju ˈdɑlərz ə mʌnθ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many packages do you offer?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are three tiers right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you offer a yearly option?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, paying yearly saves you money.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I see all the prices?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can show you the list.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would the basic tier be enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is enough for one screen.
dialogue.zh: 只有一個螢幕的話夠用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which tier do you use at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ tɪr du ju juz ət hoʊm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I use the middle option at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ juz ðə ˈmɪdəl ˈɑpʃən ət hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 我在家用中間那個選項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I pay for it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can pay on the website.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there an ad-free option?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The top package has no ads.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who can help me pick a package?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu kæn hɛlp mi pɪk ə ˈpækɪdʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 誰可以幫我挑一個套餐？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The agent can help you today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can I start watching shows?
dialogue.zh: 我什麼時候可以開始看？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can start right after paying.
dialogue.zh: 付款後馬上就能開始看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is that option so cheap?
dialogue.zh: 那個選項為什麼這麼便宜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because it shows short ads sometimes.
dialogue.zh: 因為它偶爾會播短廣告。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does a full year cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ə fʊl jɪr kɔst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a much better deal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do subtitles come with the basic tier?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈsʌbˌtaɪtəlz kʌm wɪð ðə ˈbeɪsɪk tɪr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, subtitles come with every level.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a family plan?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the family tier covers four people.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈfæməli tɪr ˈkʌvərz fɔr ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 有，家庭等級可以四個人用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could the middle plan be worth it?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ðə ˈmɪdəl plæn bi wɜrθ ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is worth it for two screens.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz wɜrθ ɪt fər tu skrinz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I change my package later?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can change it next month.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which plan is the most popular?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The middle tier is the most popular.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɪdəl tɪr ɪz ðə moʊst ˈpɑpjələr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the price of both?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will write the numbers down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we pick the package online?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在線上選套餐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The website shows every option.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any free trial for new users?
dialogue.zh: 有給新用戶的免費試用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the trial lasts seven days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which option gives the best value?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The yearly choice has the best value.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈjɪrli tʃɔɪs hæz ðə bɛst ˈvælju/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do all tiers have the same shows?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ɔl tɪrz hæv ðə seɪm ʃoʊz?/
dialogue.zh: 所有等級的節目都一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they share the same shows.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So which package should I pick?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with the cheap plan first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to watch that series tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə wɑtʃ ðæt ˈsɪriz təˈnaɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the top plan.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does that option cost?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It costs more than the basic one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kɔsts mɔr ðæn ðə ˈbeɪsɪk wʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which plan has the newest movies?
dialogue.zh: 哪個方案有最新的電影？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the top plan has them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the price the same every month?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə praɪs ðə seɪm ˈɛvri mʌnθ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the price never changes at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə praɪs ˈnɛvər ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz ət ɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you offer a student discount?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, students pay a little less.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the top tier include?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It includes four screens and sports.
dialogue.zh: 它包含四個螢幕和體育節目。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I pay for six months?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a six-month option.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who pays for the family plan?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My brother pays for that one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will yearly billing cost less for us?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ˈjɪrli ˈbɪlɪŋ kɔst lɛs fər ʌs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you save money every year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I see the total cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ si ðə ˈtoʊtəl kɔst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The total is on the last page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtoʊtəl ɪz ɑn ðə læst peɪdʒ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many screens does each plan allow?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni skrinz dʌz itʃ plæn əˈlaʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 每個方案可以有幾個螢幕？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me list them for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could there be a cheaper plan?
dialogue.zh: 會不會有更便宜的方案？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but it has short ads.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does the new price start?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The new price starts next month.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I cancel the subscription anytime?
dialogue.zh: 我可以隨時取消訂閱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you can cancel it anytime.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one gives us two screens?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The middle one comes with two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I pay right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you can pay on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens after the free trial?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your chosen plan starts charging you.
dialogue.zh: 你選的方案就會開始收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the basic plan is worth it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ðə ˈbeɪsɪk plæn ɪz wɜrθ ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 基本方案也許真的值得？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is worth it for one person.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz wɜrθ ɪt fər wʌn ˈpɜrsən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you show me the plans again?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju ʃoʊ mi ðə plænz əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以再給我看一次方案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, here are all three plans.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one do most people choose?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people pick the middle tier.
dialogue.zh: 大部分人都挑中間等級。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the yearly plan good?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ðə ˈjɪrli plæn ɡʊd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is good for twelve months.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does the middle plan cost more?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ðə ˈmɪdəl plæn kɔst mɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 中間方案為什麼比較貴？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because it gives you better quality.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take money every month?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we charge you every month.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Might the top plan cost too much?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪt ðə tɑp plæn kɔst tu mʌtʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 最高級方案會不會太貴？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is fine for four people.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So which one do you suggest?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the middle plan this month.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are your picture details sharper than mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr jʊr ˈpɪktʃər ˈditeɪlz ˈʃɑrpər ðæn maɪn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is sharper and brighter.
dialogue.zh: 我的比較銳利也比較亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which plan streams in real four K?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ plæn strimz ɪn ril fɔr keɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 哪個方案能串流真正的 4K？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The top plan does, but costs more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɑp plæn dʌz bʌt kɔsts mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 最高階方案可以，但比較貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many people can watch at once?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈpipəl kæn wɑtʃ æt wʌns?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The top plan allows four screens.
dialogue.zh: 最高級方案允許四個螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a free trial?
dialogue.zh: 我可以拿到免費試用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first week is completely free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I watch my favorite show?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ wɑtʃ maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ʃoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在哪裡看最愛的節目？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That show is on another service.
dialogue.zh: 那個節目在別家平台上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have to sign a contract?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ hæv tə saɪn ə ˈkɑntrækt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can cancel any month.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the four K plan cost more?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə fɔr keɪ plæn kɔst mɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It costs a little more each month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kɔsts ə ˈlɪtəl mɔr itʃ mʌnθ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can two people share one account?
dialogue.zh: 兩個人可以共用一個帳號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two people can share it easily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does high definition look good enough?
dialogue.zh: 高畫質對我們來說夠好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For most shows, high definition looks fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr moʊst ʃoʊz haɪ ˌdɛfəˈnɪʃən lʊks faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 大部分節目高畫質看起來就不錯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which service has the show I want?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈsɜrvɪs hæz ðə ʃoʊ aɪ wɑnt?/
dialogue.zh: 哪個服務有我想要的節目？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A different service has that one.
dialogue.zh: 有另一個服務有那個節目。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does the free trial last?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ðə fri ˈtraɪəl læst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lasts for one full week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there ads on the cheaper plan?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðɛr ædz ɑn ðə ˈtʃipər plæn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That option shows ads sometimes.
dialogue.zh: 那個選項有時候會有廣告。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I try it before I pay?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ traɪ ɪt bɪˈfɔr aɪ peɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在付錢前試用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can try it tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the trial need my card number?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈtraɪəl nid maɪ kɑrd ˈnʌmbər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It needs the number, but charges nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt nidz ðə ˈnʌmbər bʌt ˈtʃɑrdʒɪz ˈnʌθɪŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you think the picture looks clear?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju θɪŋk ðə ˈpɪktʃər lʊks klɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 你覺得這個畫面看起來清楚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stays clear on every screen size.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt steɪz klɪr ɑn ˈɛvri skrin saɪz/
dialogue.zh: 在各種螢幕尺寸上都清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many screens does your plan allow?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni skrinz dʌz jʊr plæn əˈlaʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 你的方案允許幾個螢幕？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My plan allows two screens.
dialogue.zh: 我的方案允許兩個螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is four K so much sharper?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz fɔr keɪ soʊ mʌtʃ ˈʃɑrpər?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼 4K 清楚這麼多？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because it has more pixels.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the trial end without any warning?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ˈtraɪəl ɛnd wɪˈðaʊt ˈɛni ˈwɔrnɪŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We send a reminder first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can we watch your favorite show?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn wi wɑtʃ jʊr ˈfeɪvərɪt ʃoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們在哪裡能看到你最愛的節目？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on a rival service.
dialogue.zh: 它在競爭對手的平台上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we watch the same show together?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi wɑtʃ ðə seɪm ʃoʊ təˈɡɛðər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以一起看同一個節目嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two screens can play it together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which is more important, quality or price?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ɪz mɔr ɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈkwɑləti ɔr praɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 畫質和價格哪個更重要？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For me, the price matters more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a yearly plan lock me in?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ə ˈjɪrli plæn lɑk mi ɪn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It locks you in for one year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lɑks ju ɪn fɔr wʌn jɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I switch plans in the middle?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ swɪtʃ plænz ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can switch whenever you want.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are new members getting it free?
dialogue.zh: 新會員試用是免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New members always get one free.
dialogue.zh: 新會員都能免費試一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we compare the two plans now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃæl wi kəmˈpɛr ðə tu plænz naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在比較一下兩個方案好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us compare them side by side.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs kəmˈpɛr ðɛm saɪd baɪ saɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they offer a trial week?
dialogue.zh: 他們有提供試用一週嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they give one free week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which plan gives the best picture quality?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ plæn ɡɪvz ðə bɛst ˈpɪktʃər ˈkwɑləti?/
dialogue.zh: 哪個方案提供最好的畫質？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The biggest plan gives the best picture.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbɪɡəst plæn ɡɪvz ðə bɛst ˈpɪktʃər/
dialogue.zh: 最大的方案提供最好的畫質。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can three people watch the same movie?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn θri ˈpipəl wɑtʃ ðə seɪm ˈmuvi?/
dialogue.zh: 三個人可以看同一部電影嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if three stay on one plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪf θri steɪ ɑn wʌn plæn/
dialogue.zh: 可以，只要三個人都用同一個方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the cheaper plan really work well?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈtʃipər plæn ˈrɪli wɜrk wɛl?/
dialogue.zh: 便宜的方案真的夠用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, for one person it works well.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fɔr wʌn ˈpɜrsən ɪt wɜrks wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 是的，一個人用的話就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the show I love cost extra?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ʃoʊ aɪ lʌv kɔst ˈɛkstrə?/
dialogue.zh: 我愛的那個節目要另外付費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but it is on another app.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bʌt ɪt ɪz ɑn əˈnʌðər æp/
dialogue.zh: 不用，但它在另一個應用程式上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Must I keep the plan for months?
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌst aɪ kip ðə plæn fɔr mʌnθs?/
dialogue.zh: 我必須訂這個方案好幾個月嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you may stop after one month.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ju meɪ stɑp ˈæftər wʌn mʌnθ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How clear is the picture at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ klɪr ɪz ðə ˈpɪktʃər æt naɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stays very clear in dark rooms.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt steɪz ˈvɛri klɪr ɪn dɑrk rumz/
dialogue.zh: 在暗房間裡還是很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would four K look much better?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On big screens, four K looks sharper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn bɪɡ skrinz fɔr keɪ lʊks ˈʃɑrpər/
dialogue.zh: 在大螢幕上，4K 看起來更銳利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my sister use my account too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn maɪ ˈsɪstər juz maɪ əˈkaʊnt tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我妹妹也能用我的帳號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if she uses a second screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪf ʃi ˈjuzɪz ə ˈsɛkənd skrin/
dialogue.zh: 可以，只要她用第二個螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there limits on our devices?
dialogue.zh: 我們的裝置有數量限制嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the limit is four devices.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where else can I find that series?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɛls kæn aɪ faɪnd ðæt ˈsɪriz?/
dialogue.zh: 我還能在哪裡找到那個影集？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Another service has the whole series.
dialogue.zh: 另一家平台有整部影集。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pause the plan for summer?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pɔz ðə plæn fɔr ˈsʌmər?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在夏天暫停方案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you can pause it once.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the trial include every channel?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It includes most channels but not all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪnˈkludz moʊst ˈtʃænəlz bʌt nɑt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 包含大部分頻道，但不是全部。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could a yearly contract save us money?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ə ˈjɪrli ˈkɑntrækt seɪv ʌs ˈmʌni?/
dialogue.zh: 年約能幫我們省點錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but for a whole year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much better is the top plan?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ˈbɛtər ɪz ðə tɑp plæn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is better in quality and screens.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈbɛtər ɪn ˈkwɑləti ænd skrinz/
dialogue.zh: 它在畫質和螢幕數上都更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the free trial ask for money?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə fri ˈtraɪəl æsk fɔr ˈmʌni?/
dialogue.zh: 免費試用會要求付錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not now, only after the trial ends.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt naʊ ˈoʊnli ˈæftər ðə ˈtraɪəl ɛndz/
dialogue.zh: 現在不會，試用結束後才會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which shows are missing from this service?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ʃoʊz ɑr ˈmɪsɪŋ frʌm ðɪs ˈsɜrvɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 哪些節目這家平台沒有？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your favorite one is missing here.
dialogue.zh: 你最愛的那個這裡沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the picture stay smooth during action?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ˈpɪktʃər steɪ smuð ˈdʊrɪŋ ˈækʃən?/
dialogue.zh: 動作場面時畫面會保持順暢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it stays smooth on strong internet.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt steɪz smuð ɑn strɔŋ ˈɪntərnɛt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we both need our own account?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi boʊθ nid aʊr oʊn əˈkaʊnt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們兩個都需要自己的帳號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, one account holds two profiles.
dialogue.zh: 不用，一個帳號能有兩個使用者。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I end the contract early?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but you pay a small fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ju peɪ ə smɔl fi/
dialogue.zh: 可以，但要付一筆小費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can anybody join the free trial?
dialogue.zh: 任何人都能加入免費試用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, anybody new can try it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which plan do you like the most?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ plæn du ju laɪk ðə moʊst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like the middle plan the best.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðə ˈmɪdəl plæn ðə bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡中間那個方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the price rise after the trial?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə praɪs raɪz ˈæftər ðə ˈtraɪəl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the normal price starts then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are all the episodes on this service?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ɔl ði ˈɛpəsoʊdz ɑn ðɪs ˈsɜrvɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 所有集數都在這家平台上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the last season is elsewhere.
dialogue.zh: 不在，最後一季在別的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we choose the plan tonight?
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚就選方案好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let us pick it before bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs lɛt ʌs pɪk ɪt bɪˈfɔr bɛd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which package should we pick tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們該選哪個套餐？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The middle package looks best.
dialogue.zh: 中間那個套餐看起來最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the cheaper plan have sports?
dialogue.zh: 比較便宜的方案有體育節目嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, sports need the top tier.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，體育節目要最高級方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What comes with the top plan?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It comes with four screens.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you happy with that choice?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The middle tier is enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we change the plan later?
dialogue.zh: 我們之後可以換方案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can switch anytime.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the yearly plan cost us less?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ˈjɪrli plæn kɔst ʌs lɛs?/
dialogue.zh: 年繳方案會讓我們少花一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The yearly price is a bit lower.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈjɪrli praɪs ɪz ə bɪt ˈloʊər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does the contract last?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lasts for one full year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we choose the yearly plan now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi tʃuz ðə ˈjɪrli plæn naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在該選年繳方案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a better deal for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə ˈbɛtər dil fɔr ʌs/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which plan works with our old TV?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ plæn wɜrks wɪð ˈaʊər oʊld ˌtiˈvi?/
dialogue.zh: 哪個方案能搭配我們的舊電視？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The basic service works just fine.
dialogue.zh: 基本服務就完全沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the plan include two devices?
dialogue.zh: 這個方案包含兩台裝置嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two devices can stream together.
dialogue.zh: 兩台裝置可以一起播放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can we start watching shows?
dialogue.zh: 我們什麼時候可以開始看節目？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can start right after signing up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn stɑrt raɪt ˈæftər ˈsaɪnɪŋ ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 你註冊完就可以馬上開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, let us set up the payment.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt lɛt ʌs sɛt ʌp ðə ˈpeɪmənt./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們來設定付款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will open the payment page.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ wɪl ˈoʊpən ðə ˈpeɪmənt peɪdʒ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which payment method do you prefer?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I prefer to use my credit card.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ prɪˈfɜr tu juz maɪ ˈkrɛdɪt kɑrd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we pay with a card?
dialogue.zh: 我們該用信用卡付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The card is safer for the subscription.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑrd ɪz ˈseɪfər fɔr ðə səbˈskrɪpʃən./
dialogue.zh: 信用卡對訂閱來說比較安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I type the card number?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ taɪp ðə kɑrd ˈnʌmbər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type it in the first empty box.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪp ɪt ɪn ðə fɜrst ˈɛmpti bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 把它輸入第一個空格裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I put the expiry date here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ pʊt ði ɪkˈspaɪri deɪt hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 到期日我該填在這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the next one is security code.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə nɛkst wʌn ɪz səˈkjʊrəti koʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need to save this card?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid tu seɪv ðɪs kɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 我們需要儲存這張卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, saving it makes renewals much easier.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈseɪvɪŋ ɪt meɪks rɪˈnuəlz mʌtʃ ˈiziər./
dialogue.zh: 要，儲存後續訂會方便很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the monthly price again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The monthly price is shown on screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmʌnθli praɪs ɪz ʃoʊn ɑn skrin./
dialogue.zh: 月費價格顯示在螢幕上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the total include any hidden fees?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈtoʊtəl ɪnˈklud ˈɛni ˈhɪdən fiz?/
dialogue.zh: 總金額包含任何隱藏費用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the total is what you see.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə ˈtoʊtəl ɪz wʌt ju si./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，總金額就是你看到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a receipt by email?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə rɪˈsit baɪ ˈimeɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以收到電子郵件收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the slip goes to your inbox.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə slɪp ɡoʊz tu jɔr ˈɪnbɑks./
dialogue.zh: 可以，收據明細會寄到你的信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When will the payment go through?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It should go through in a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃʊd ɡoʊ θru ɪn ə ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 應該一分鐘內就會完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the payment go through already?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen says it worked.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let us set up the devices.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ lɛt ʌs sɛt ʌp ðə dɪˈvaɪsɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will start with our living room.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl stɑrt wɪð ˈaʊər ˈlɪvɪŋ rum./
dialogue.zh: 我先從我們的客廳開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you installed the app already?
dialogue.zh: 你已經安裝好應用程式了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I just installed it today.
dialogue.zh: 裝好了，我今天才安裝的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, now create the family account.
dialogue.zh: 很好，現在建立家庭帳號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will type our shared email.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ wɪl taɪp ˈaʊər ʃɛrd ˈimeɪl./
dialogue.zh: 好，我來輸入我們共用的電子郵件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should our new password be?
dialogue.zh: 我們的新密碼該設成什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us use a long safe one.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs juz ə lɔŋ seɪf wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我們用一個又長又安全的吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we add a profile for mom?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi æd ə ˈproʊfaɪl fɔr mɑm?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要幫媽媽加一個使用者嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she likes her own screen name.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʃi laɪks hɜr oʊn skrin neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 要，她喜歡有自己的顯示名稱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which email should we use here?
dialogue.zh: 我們這裡該用哪個電子郵件？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the one we both can open.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə wʌn wi boʊθ kæn ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 用我們兩個都能開的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please type the code from my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz taɪp ðə koʊd frʌm maɪ foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 請輸入我手機上的驗證碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, the code is now accepted.
dialogue.zh: 好，驗證碼已經被接受了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this account need a nickname too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs əˈkaʊnt nid ə ˈnɪkˌneɪm tu?/
dialogue.zh: 這個帳號也需要暱稱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, our family name will work.
dialogue.zh: 需要，用我們的姓氏就可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who can see our viewing history?
dialogue.zh: 誰可以看到我們的觀看紀錄？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the adults in this account.
dialogue.zh: 只有這個帳號裡的大人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we lock the kids profile?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以鎖住兒童使用者嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, set a pin for that profile.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs sɛt ə pɪn fɔr ðæt ˈproʊfaɪl./
dialogue.zh: 可以，為那個使用者設一組密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I add another device?
dialogue.zh: 我要在哪裡新增另一台裝置？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the settings and tap devices.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the tablet work with this plan?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ˈtæblət wɜrk wɪð ðɪs plæn?/
dialogue.zh: 平板能搭配這個方案使用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tablets work on any service.
dialogue.zh: 平板在任何服務上都能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I download the app first?
dialogue.zh: 我應該先下載應用程式嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then sign in with our email.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɛn saɪn ɪn wɪð ˈaʊər ˈimeɪl./
dialogue.zh: 對，然後用我們的電子郵件登入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you sign in on the tablet?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju saɪn ɪn ɑn ðə ˈtæblət?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it shows the same shows now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ʃoʊz ðə seɪm ʃoʊz naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 登入了，現在顯示一樣的節目。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are our phones connected to it?
dialogue.zh: 我們的手機也連上了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, both phones are connected already.
dialogue.zh: 對，兩支手機都已經連上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many devices can stream together?
dialogue.zh: 同時可以幾台裝置一起播放？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our package allows two screens at once.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊr ˈpækɪdʒ əˈlaʊz tu skrinz æt wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 我們的套餐允許同時兩台螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we name the living room TV?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi neɪm ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ rum ˌtiˈvi?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要幫客廳的電視取名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that makes devices easier to find.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæt meɪks dɪˈvaɪsɪz ˈiziər tu faɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 要，這樣比較容易找到裝置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has the account finally become ready?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, everything is set up well.
dialogue.zh: 好了，所有東西都設定妥當。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us check the account details again.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs tʃɛk ði əˈkaʊnt ˈditeɪlz əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 我們再檢查一次帳號資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, I will read them aloud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə aɪ wɪl rid ðɛm əˈlaʊd./
dialogue.zh: 好主意，我來把它們念出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we turn on the renewal reminder?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi tɜrn ɑn ðə rɪˈnuəl rɪˈmaɪndər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要開啟續訂提醒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a reminder helps us remember dates.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə rɪˈmaɪndər hɛlps ʌs rɪˈmɛmbər deɪts./
dialogue.zh: 要，提醒可以幫我們記住日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens after the free week?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The monthly price starts right then.
dialogue.zh: 月費價格就從那時開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we keep the same password?
dialogue.zh: 我們要繼續用同樣的密碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please keep it somewhere safe.
dialogue.zh: 對，請把它放在安全的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I spell the email address right?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ spɛl ði ˈimeɪl əˈdrɛs raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我把電子郵件地址拼對了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I checked every single letter.
dialogue.zh: 對，我每個字母都檢查過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does our subscription really start?
dialogue.zh: 我們的訂閱到底什麼時候開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It starts as soon as payment clears.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑrts æz sun æz ˈpeɪmənt klɪrz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please save all the login details.
dialogue.zh: 請把所有的登入資料存好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, they are in our notes app.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ðeɪ ɑr ɪn ˈaʊər noʊts æp./
dialogue.zh: 好了，它們在我們的筆記應用程式裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we set up the bedroom TV?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi sɛt ʌp ðə ˈbɛdˌrum ˌtiˈvi?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要設定臥室的電視嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will do it tomorrow morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ wɪl du ɪt təˈmɑroʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the account picture upload fine?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it appeared on the profile page.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt əˈpɪrd ɑn ðə ˈproʊfaɪl peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 順利，它出現在個人頁面上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alright, everything is ready for tonight.
dialogue.zh: 好，今晚的一切都準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, let us find something to watch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt lɛt ʌs faɪnd ˈsʌmθɪŋ tu wɑtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們來找點東西看吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us add it to our list.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs æd ɪt tu aʊr lɪst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, I will press the button.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has it been saved to my watchlist?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæz ɪt bɪn seɪvd tu maɪ ˈwɑtʃlɪst?/
dialogue.zh: 它已經存進我的片單了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it shows a small check mark.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ʃoʊz ə smɔl tʃɛk mɑrk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which button opens my saved shows?
dialogue.zh: 哪個按鈕打開我存的節目？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one with the bookmark picture.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is this list so short today?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðɪs lɪst soʊ ʃɔrt təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 今天這份片單為什麼這麼短？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You only added two shows so far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈoʊnli ˈædəd tu ʃoʊz soʊ fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 你目前只加了兩部節目。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you turn on the subtitles?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, they are on the bottom now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ðeɪ ɑr ɑn ðə ˈbɑtəm naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 可以，它們現在在最下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I make the subtitles bigger?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ meɪk ðə ˈsʌbˌtaɪtəlz ˈbɪgər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the settings and choose large text.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðə ˈsɛtɪŋz ænd tʃuz lɑrdʒ tɛkst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want English subtitles or none?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt ˈɪŋglɪʃ ˈsʌbˌtaɪtəlz ɔr nʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 你要英文字幕還是都不要？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: English is fine, but keep them small.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪŋglɪʃ ɪz faɪn bʌt kip ðɛm smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 英文就好，但讓它們小一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did the subtitles go just now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd ðə ˈsʌbˌtaɪtəlz goʊ dʒʌst naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You hid them with the yellow button.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hɪd ðɛm wɪð ðə ˈjɛloʊ ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 你用黃色按鈕把它們藏起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you hearing it clearly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a little soft for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə ˈlɪtəl sɔft fɔr mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I raise the volume a bit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ reɪz ðə ˈvɑljum ə bɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我該把音量調高一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two steps should be enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does the sound keep going up?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ðə saʊnd kip ˈgoʊɪŋ ʌp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are holding that button down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we use headphones for this?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以用耳機看這個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, the baby is sleeping.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are your headphones in the desk drawer?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr jʊr ˈhɛdˌfoʊnz ɪn ðə dɛsk drɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 你的耳機在書桌抽屜裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they are on the shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these headphones need to be charged?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðiz ˈhɛdˌfoʊnz nid tu bi tʃɑrdʒd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they are almost empty now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the charging cable for them?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə ˈtʃɑrdʒɪŋ ˈkeɪbəl fɔr ðɛm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is next to the television.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the big light go off?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please turn off the big light.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz tɜrn ɔf ðə bɪg laɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has the small lamp stayed on there?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæz ðə smɔl læmp steɪd ɑn ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 小燈還一直亮在那裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has, but it is very dim.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hæz bʌt ɪt ɪz ˈvɛri dɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which light should we leave on?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small one near the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the room so dark now?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðə rum soʊ dɑrk naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 房間現在為什麼這麼暗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We turned off every light except one.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tɜrnd ɔf ˈɛvri laɪt ɪkˈsɛpt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我們只留一盞，其他都關了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we start the first episode now?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi stɑrt ðə fɜrst ˈɛpəˌsoʊd naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在可以開始看第一集嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I am pressing play right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ æm ˈprɛsɪŋ pleɪ raɪt naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is this first episode?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is about forty minutes long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it start with a slow scene?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt stɑrt wɪð ə sloʊ sin?/
dialogue.zh: 它一開始是緩慢的場景嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the opening is very quiet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is the man in the coat?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɪz ðə mæn ɪn ðə koʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 穿大衣的那個男人是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is the main character, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz ðə meɪn ˈkærəktər aɪ θɪŋk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we pause for a moment?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I want to keep watching.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you comfortable on the sofa?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the blanket is warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you pass me the remote please?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju pæs mi ðə rɪˈmoʊt pliz?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以把遙控器遞給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, next to your hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz nɛkst tu jʊr hænd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the show loading slowly tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðə ʃoʊ ˈloʊdɪŋ ˈsloʊli təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 今晚這部節目為什麼載入這麼慢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The internet is slow tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I see the episode number?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ si ði ˈɛpəˌsoʊd ˈnʌmbər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is under the title in gray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈʌndər ðə ˈtaɪtəl ɪn ɡreɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why are the subtitles behind the picture?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɑr ðə ˈsʌbˌtaɪtəlz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈpɪktʃər?/
dialogue.zh: 字幕為什麼在畫面後面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Choose the top layer in subtitle settings.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃuz ðə tɑp ˈleɪər ɪn ˈsʌbˌtaɪtəl ˈsɛtɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 在字幕設定裡選最上層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you like the white subtitles?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yellow is easier for my eyes.
dialogue.zh: 黃色對我的眼睛比較輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I change the subtitle color?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈsʌbˌtaɪtəl ˈkʌlər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick the color wheel, then yellow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we keep the volume this low?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi kip ðə ˈvɑljum ðɪs loʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要保持音量這麼低嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the neighbors are asleep already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I mute the loud background music?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ mjut ðə laʊd ˈbækˌgraʊnd ˈmjuzɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把吵的背景音樂靜音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that would remove all the sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðæt wʊd rɪˈmuv ɔl ðə saʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 不行，那會把全部聲音去掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any night mode for the sound?
dialogue.zh: 聲音有夜間模式可以用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it keeps quiet parts louder.
dialogue.zh: 有，它會讓小聲的部分變大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What setting did you just turn on?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈsɛtɪŋ dɪd ju dʒʌst tɜrn ɑn?/
dialogue.zh: 你剛打開的是哪個設定？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The night mode for the sound.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the wall lamp switch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is behind the tall plant.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we keep the small lamp on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃæl wi kip ðə smɔl læmp ɑn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們能讓小燈一直開著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is what we are doing now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz wɑt wi ɑr ˈduɪŋ naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the screen so bright?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lower the brightness in the picture menu.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈloʊər ðə ˈbraɪtnəs ɪn ðə ˈpɪktʃər ˈmɛnju./
dialogue.zh: 在畫面選單裡把亮度調低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are your eyes more comfortable now?
dialogue.zh: 你的眼睛現在舒服一點了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much better, thank you very much.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is that woman at the desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɪz ðæt ˈwʊmən æt ðə dɛsk?/
dialogue.zh: 在辦公桌那裡的女人是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is his sister from the city.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz hɪz ˈsɪstər frʌm ðə ˈsɪti./
dialogue.zh: 她是他從城裡來的妹妹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you understand what they are saying?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ˌʌndərˈstænd wɑt ðeɪ ɑr ˈseɪɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 你聽得懂他們在說什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, but they speak quite fast.
dialogue.zh: 大致懂，但他們說得挺快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we slow the speed a little?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi sloʊ ðə spid ə ˈlɪtəl?/
dialogue.zh: 我們該把速度稍微調慢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I can follow it well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many episodes are in this season?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈɛpəˌsoʊdz ɑr ɪn ðɪs ˈsizən?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are eight episodes in this season.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɑr eɪt ˈɛpəˌsoʊdz ɪn ðɪs ˈsizən./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we watch one more after this?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi wɑtʃ wʌn mɔr ˈæftər ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 這集之後我們可以再看一集嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you stay awake for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ju steɪ əˈweɪk fɔr ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are your eyes getting heavy already?
dialogue.zh: 你的眼睛已經開始重了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, but the story is good.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl bʌt ðə ˈstɔri ɪz gʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you put the second blanket?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd ju pʊt ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈblæŋkɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你把第二條毯子放哪了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is folded on the chair.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why did the picture suddenly stop?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The internet dropped for two seconds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did it start playing after the pause?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ɪt stɑrt ˈpleɪɪŋ ˈæftər ðə pɔz?/
dialogue.zh: 暫停後它又開始播了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is running smoothly now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I make the room warmer?
dialogue.zh: 我該讓房間暖和一些嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, my feet are cold.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we watch one more?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just one, then we sleep.

issues.note: 非 error 級殘留：a70「How many screens does each plan allow?」b71 只回「Let me list them for you.」未吐數字；同型以評語代數字者另有 27（How much does a full year cost? → It is a much better deal.）與 235（monthly price → shown on screen）。因全篇禁寫金額、且 70 之後緊接 74／80／106 給出台數資訊，屬可接受的迴避式回應；建議 71 直接給一台數更佳。

非 error 級殘留：b353「The internet is slow tonight.」近乎複述 a352「Why is the show loading slowly tonight?」，385 亦回音問句「How many episodes are in this season?」；廣告句 025／123 與「想看的那部在別家服務」母題（109／119／137／159／171）多次換句話說——機器整句重複檢查為 0，皆屬改寫式變化，非硬重複。
非 error 級殘留：364「neighbours」為英式拼法，與全篇美式（favorite、gray）不一致，宜作 neighbors；另 311（choose large text）與 313（keep them small）字幕大小偏好略互斥，屬兩人偏好差異、非設定矛盾。

review.summary_zh: 第三輪複驗：上一輪點名的 061（改為 It includes four screens and sports.）、063（改為 There is a six-month option.）、040（改為 Can we pick the package online?，且 041 不再與 149 撞句）、177（縮為 6 詞）全部到位，段 3 Yes/No 起句亦明顯下降；依四項判準（空心回應／WH 被 Yes-No 回答／設定矛盾／結尾未收束）本輪無 error。固定事實全篇一致：basic 1 台、middle 2 台、top 4 台、月繳年繳、試用一週七天、字幕全等級、無任何具體金額。C 項依機器證據給分（hard=0、SUSPECT 0、逐詞對齊通過）。
